prompts.mythfall-terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture atlas for a top-down 2D fantasy village battle map, Dungeondraft-inspired hand-painted tabletop map art.
Generate ONE square image, 2048 by 2048 preferred, divided into EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows, with no gutters, border, labels or lines between quadrants. Each equal quadrant is its own flat orthographic seamless material sample filling all of its quadrant to the edges. Upper-left: muted mossy green meadow grass, fine blades and tiny bare patches, no objects. Upper-right: weathered warm earth path, subtle pebbles and ochre soil, no objects. Lower-left: worn grey-brown cobblestone paving, irregular tightly packed small rounded stones with dark grout, no objects. Lower-right: aged oak floor boards in horizontal parallel rows, warm medium brown, subtle grain and joins, no objects.
Art direction: richly textured but quiet and legible at game scale, restrained earthy tones, fine dark contours, hand-drawn map materials. Flat even overhead ambient light, no perspective, no vignette, no dramatic shadows. Approximately 8 stones or boards across each quadrant. Each quadrant must tile convincingly with itself. Do not depict a whole map, UI, buildings, characters, scenery, text, watermarks, frames or decorative edges.
prompts.mythfall-props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game prop sprite atlas for a Dungeondraft-inspired top-down fantasy village battle map.
Generate ONE square PNG with a genuinely transparent background, 2048x2048 preferred. Arrange EXACTLY 16 separate sprites in a strict uniform 4-column by 4-row grid. Each sprite entirely contained in its cell with a generous transparent margin, centered, no labels, no grid drawn, no duplicates beyond what is requested. Camera directly overhead, orthographic, all sprites on the same scale and angle, finely inked and hand-painted, textured wood and stone, earthy muted colors with warm highlights, compact contact shadows only.
Row 1 left to right: (1) one square block of old thick grey-brown masonry wall viewed directly from above, fills almost entire cell; (2) one closed sturdy oak door with iron bands viewed from above, horizontal orientation; (3) one round stone village well with a dark water opening, no roof; (4) one rectangular oak tavern table with one tiny lit candle and mug.
Row 2 left to right: (1) a compact cluster of three wooden barrels viewed from above; (2) a narrow wooden bed with rust red blanket and cream pillow; (3) a small stone hearth with glowing warm embers; (4) a low dense green shrub.
Row 3 left to right: (1) a simple iron longsword lying on the ground, blade pointing upward; (2) a brass hand lantern, seen from above; (3) a bread roll and red apple; (4) a closed worn leather journal.
Row 4 left to right: (1) a small wooden storage chest, viewed from above; (2) a single wooden chair facing upward; (3) a round wooden shield; (4) a small cluster of grey rocks.
Keep all cells free of any scenery or painted floor. Transparent background, no checkerboard rendered into the image, no lettering, no UI, no perspective or isometric elevation. These assets will be independently placed at exact simulated coordinates; not a concept-art collage.
prompts.mythfall-characters:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character sprite atlas for a top-down 2D tabletop fantasy village battle map, Dungeondraft-inspired finely inked hand-painted art.
Generate ONE landscape PNG 1536x1024 preferred with genuinely transparent background. EXACTLY 6 separate full-body character sprites in a precise grid of 3 columns and 2 rows. Equal square cells with generous empty margins, every sprite centered. Camera DIRECTLY OVERHEAD looking down at the tops of heads and shoulders, as tactical battle map tokens, no isometric view, no face-on portraits. All characters face toward the bottom of the image. No circular bases or frames. Small compact contact shadows, muted earthy cloth, textured leather, readable silhouette, warm subtly shaded natural colors.
Top row left to right: (1) a human traveler in a moss green cloak, brown leather pack, brown hair, simple boots; (2) Old Nessa, a grey-haired elderly herbalist in a faded lavender shawl carrying a little herb basket; (3) Tommen Ash, a stocky red-haired innkeeper in an ochre shirt and leather apron.
Bottom row left to right: (1) Mara Vell, a dark-haired human reeve in a dusty blue coat; (2) Ellis Crow, a slender human scholar in a desaturated teal robe, dark hair, small brown satchel; (3) Brakka, a sturdy orc toll keeper with muted olive skin, russet red coat and leather shoulder guards holding a short wooden cudgel.
Consistent overhead camera, scale, art style and light on all six. Each character fits entirely within its cell. No terrain, scenery, floor, checkerboard, text, lettering, labels, portraits, perspective horizon, UI or watermarks.
prompts.mythfall-characters-cutout: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached six-character sprite sheet. Keep all six characters, their appearance, poses, scale, exact positions and the 1536x1024 three-column by two-row grid unchanged. Remove ALL of the painted brown, green, blue and black atmospheric gradient background between and around the characters. Make that background genuinely 100% transparent with alpha zero. Each character must be an isolated clean game cutout with fully opaque painted surfaces and antialiased edges. No halos, colored mist, ground, circular frames, added elements, lettering or checkerboard. Preserve the existing character art; change only the background/transparency.
